authorization: User explicitly requested continuing D after the static gray-zone result. This amendment was registered before D, not before the static sweep
static_decision_preserved: CONDITIONAL: original automatic D admission was false; no GO or CUDA promotion
scope: CPU-only count/byte-model simulation, not a realized index, measured I/O or end-to-end speed
packing: Apply each frozen permutation once, fill blocks sequentially to initial active capacity. Physical capacity remains 256; deleting leaves holes, inserting uses lowest vacant slot, never compact untouched vectors
global_pivots: Snapshot-global pivot coordinate copies are frozen; deleting a pivot occurrence does not discard its coordinate copy. No reselection. Insert coordinates are drawn from the retained original-vector lineage as in the actual trace
best_match: Minimize sum over P of (insert-to-pivot norm minus current mean block-to-pivot norm)^2 across live blocks; ties lowest block ID. If any empty block exists, lowest empty block first. No query/reference/oracle used in placement
insert: Match once. If a slot is vacant, insert locally. If full, sort 257 occurrence IDs by (distance to first frozen pivot, occurrence ID), retain lower 128 in original block and upper 129 in a new block. Retained existing IDs keep their slots; only IDs transferred to new block are moved. New object uses first available slot
delete: Exact immutable occurrence ID; remove that slot, no movement of survivors, no merges in this bounded trace
certificates: Refresh only blocks whose membership changed. Use existing conservative per-object distance intervals with fixed global pivots; no oracle for certificate construction
denominators: Distinct changed blocks (including new split blocks) / initial total blocks; moved existing distinct occurrences / initial N; actual movement events / actual I+D also retained
bytes: Coordinate-payload model = 4*D*(all copied existing/new-live vector move events + inserts). Certificate-write model = 16*P*refresh calls. Not measured DRAM, PCIe, allocation, or latency
query_tradeoff: Recompute static and post-update query survival/oracle for this slack packing, dividing by its actual total physical blocks. Do not plot pre-slack static 256 results as if they were the slack organization
correctness: Check slots/ownership after each event, affected block bounds cover all members, final exact occurrence and lineage deltas match retained next snapshot. All 32 post-update queries must have zero false prune
promotion: Locality alone cannot rescue the failed cheap-query gate. Final decision remains CONDITIONAL unless the original same-configuration static GO gates and D gates all pass; no new P>8 or CUDA kernel
